name: Swiss Potato Soup
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Wash, pare, and cut potatoes in halves.
Wash, pare, and cut turnips in one-quarter inch slices.
Parboil together ten minutes, drain, add onion cut in slices, and three cups boiling water.
Cook until vegetables are soft; drain, reserving the water to add to vegetables after rubbing them through a sieve.
Add milk, reheat, and bind with butter and flour cooked together.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
